How it works

From your phone to paper in three steps

  1. Join the same Wi‑Fi

    Connect your iPhone to the network your printer uses. Printwell finds printers on its own and asks iOS for Local Network access, which is all it’s used for.

  2. Choose what to print

    A PDF, a Word file, photos, a web page or whatever you just copied. Check the preview and pick a layout.

  3. Tap Print

    The job goes straight to the printer, and Printwell shows what happens next: printing, low ink, out of paper or a jam.

FAQ

Questions people ask

How do I print from my iPhone to a wireless printer?

Connect your iPhone to the same Wi‑Fi as the printer and open Printwell. It finds the printer by itself. Choose a file, photo or web page, check the preview and tap Print. From other apps, tap Share › Print with Printwell.

Does it work with HP, Canon, Epson and Brother printers?

Yes, and with thousands of other Wi‑Fi printers that support AirPrint or IPP, which covers most home and office printers from the last decade. No maker app or driver needed. Printwell is independent and not affiliated with these brands.

Why can’t my iPhone find my printer?

Usually the phone and printer are on different networks (such as a guest network), Local Network access is off, the printer is asleep, or the router keeps devices apart. Fix connection in Printwell checks each cause and lets you add the printer by IP address. See the support page.

Can I scan to PDF with my printer’s scanner?

Yes, if your printer’s scanner works over the network. Printwell uses the glass or the feeder, two-sided, at 150 to 600 dpi, and saves a searchable PDF. No scanner? Use the camera.

How do I check my printer’s ink levels?

Open Printwell: the printer card shows ink or toner, paper and jams live, as reported by the printer. Some printers report only approximate levels, or none with refilled cartridges.

Which files can I print?

PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, Numbers, Keynote, RTF, HTML, CSV, Markdown and images including HEIC and multi-page TIFF, plus photos, web pages and the clipboard.

Do I need a driver, an account or a cable?

No driver and no account: Printwell talks to the printer over Wi‑Fi. iPhone can’t print over a USB cable. No router? Many printers offer Wi‑Fi Direct; see support.

How much does Printwell cost?

Printwell is a subscription: weekly, monthly or yearly. The monthly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers. Prices vary by country and are shown in your currency before you confirm.

How do I cancel my subscription?

Open iOS Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions › Printwell, or tap Settings › Manage subscription in Printwell. Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial or period ends. Refunds: reportaproblem.apple.com.

Which iPhones and iPads are supported?

Any iPhone or iPad with iOS 16 or later. Printwell speaks 35 languages and follows your device’s language.
